arts.ttl: Transcript: Xabi Alonso’s Post-Match Press Conference Following Real Madrid’s UCL Win vs Olympiacos
arts.sum: Real Madrid took the three points in a seven-goal thriller against Olympiacos in Matchday 5 of the Champions League. Overall, despite the difficulties we faced because Eduardo (Camavinga) couldn’t play at halftime and Raúl (Asencio) had a hamstring problem, we managed to come away with a win thanks to positive things like Kylian’s goals, Vin Jr.’s performance, and other players who also did very well.”

arts.ttl: Mbappe scores four as Real Madrid defeat Olympiacos
arts.sum: Kylian Mbappe scores four times for Real Madrid to secure a 4-3 win against Olympiacos.

arts.ttl: Real Madrid Player Ratings vs. Olympiacos: Mbappe Resurrects Struggling Attack
arts.sum: Real Madrid snapped their three-game winless streak with a much-needed 4–3 victory against Olympiacos on Wednesday evening thanks to a sensational performance from Kylian Mbappé. Despite dominating the rest of the first half and the early minutes of the second, lazy defending from Real Madrid let Olympiacos back into the game.
